purpose: Additive Clarity Router-to-child-Shortcut contract. Existing Clarity executors remain the fallback until physical iPhone E2E passes.

understand_layer.cutover_rule: Keep fallback until the Use Model -> Router -> child Shortcut path passes physical iPhone E2E.

legacy_compatibility.normalization: needs_confirmation is canonical for modular actions; when a legacy action is adapted, effective confirmation is needs_confirmation OR requires_confirmation.
legacy_compatibility.cutover: Do not remove or bypass the existing executor path until the preferred Use Model modular path passes physical iPhone E2E and rollback checks.

completion_scope.goal: Clarity is the single normal entry point for every iPhone capability that can be reached through public iOS automation surfaces or an existing registered YOS asset.
completion_scope.protected_action_rule: If iOS requires explicit user interaction or exposes no public automation API, route to the nearest native UI instead of pretending the action ran.
completion_scope.dynamic_app_rule: Installed third-party App Intents are device-dependent and must be registered/verified before execution.
completion_scope.physical_acceptance: No capability route is complete until its real iPhone path reaches Verify/Ledger successfully.
